thesis: Fundamentals are strong and undisputed: revenue grew 58.1% YoY and is accelerating, net income is up 156.8%, there is 568.8M of cash against 7.9M of debt, and earnings (2027-02-23) fall outside the window. The trend is clean (close 102.72 > SMA20 95.1 > SMA50 84.9 > SMA200 64.7), and healthcare (XLV) is a leading sector. Still, the stock is 8% above its SMA20 after a +40.8% 21-day run, in a risk-off tape (VIX 31.19, 99th percentile). Reward/risk is only 1.08 at the 102.72 close, 1.22 at the 102.09 pre-market price and 1.36 at the top of the zone (101.5), so under lesson 3 it is Hold until price pulls back. Upgrade to Overweight only on a fill at or below about 100.25, the midpoint of the zone, where R/R is 1.73.
invalidation: Daily close below 92.68 (10-day swing low), or a close back below the 20-day SMA (~95) after a failed breakout above 103.37.
key_risks: Risk-off regime: QQQ is below its 50- and 200-day averages and VIX is at the 99th percentile
Extended: 8% above SMA20, the last two up days came on fading volume (0.79 ratio), and price is near the 111.57 mean and 115 TD Cowen analyst targets
Possible follow-on offering after a ~98% 126-day run (no S-3 or 424B5 visible yet)
Unusual options activity with no identified catalyst, plus ~10% short interest, so sharp moves can go either way
Healthcare names are one correlated bet (lesson 8), so combined weight must be capped
